assessment_classification: Internal reproducible technical evaluation conducted in isolated QEMU/KVM virtual machines. This evaluation is NOT an independent third-party audit, NOT an official CIS/NIST certification, and does NOT claim a formal MTBF.
integrity_vs_signature_note: metadata/SHA256SUMS.txt provides SHA-256 cryptographic hashes for file integrity verification only. Checksums are NOT digital signatures and do not provide third-party cryptographic identity attestation.
